children: SINGAPORE and HONG KONG, Oct. 30, 2026

-- NETCLASS TECHNOLOGY INC (Nasdaq: NTCL; the “Company” or “NetClass”), a B2B smart education IT solutions provider with offices in Shanghai, Hong Kong, Singapore and Tokyo, today announced that its case study on multi-agent foreign language education received the Outstanding Case Award at the 2026 Digital Lifelong Learning International Conference.

The conference was held on October 16-17, 2026, at Shanghai Open University, co-organized by Shanghai Open University, the UNESCO Institute for Lifelong Learning (UIL), and the UNESCO Institute for Information Technologies in Education (UNESCO IITE). NetClass’s case, titled “
Multi-Agent Collaboration-Driven Foreign Language Teaching Assessment and Personalized Learning Support Practice,
” was selected from a nationwide pool of submissions on AI-empowered smart learning ecosystems.

The recognized initiative applies multi-agent architectures and large language models (LLMs) to common constraints in conventional foreign language instruction, such as limited oral practice, delayed grading feedback, and the difficulty of converting evaluation metrics into tailored lesson plans. Built on the Company’s proprietary
instruction system and

assessment engine, the platform coordinates specialized agents to analyze discrete language components, including pronunciation, vocabulary, grammar, discourse structure, and pragmatic usage. To address common LLM output variance and explainability issues, the software incorporates confidence score fusion, anomaly flagging, dynamic routing, and human instructor review for open-ended assignments like oral dialogue and composition.

At the conference, NetClass Deputy General Manager, Jing Wang, presented the case study and participated in discussions with academic researchers and industry peers on practical integration methods for AI in higher education.

“Receiving this recognition from prestigious institutions like UNESCO IITE and UIL validates our conviction that multi-agent AI architectures represent the future of educational technology,” said Dr. Jianbiao Dai, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of NetClass. “Language teachers frequently spend excessive hours on routine error correction rather than direct instruction. By assigning discrete evaluation tasks to specialized software agents with human-in-the-loop controls, our platform provides reliable, diagnostic feedback that faculty can use in real time. This award fuels our strategic ambition to continuously push the boundaries of applied AI, expanding our multi-agent framework across broader subjects, diverse languages, and new global markets to fundamentally redefine digital education.”
About NETCLASS TECHNOLOGY INC

NETCLASS TECHNOLOGY INC is a B2B smart education specialist with offices in Shanghai, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Tokyo, providing innovative IT solutions to schools, training institutions, corporations, public agencies, and other organizations. The Company’s services include SaaS subscription services and application software development, and, through its joint venture, interactive AI companion smart hardware, with solutions spanning teaching and campus management, online teaching, examinations, epidemic prevention, data storage, EDC (Education Credit) blockchain systems, and lecturer evaluation services. The Company’s mission is to deliver reliable, high-quality products that drive sustainable growth for our customers.
